'''Sebenodone''' was a chemical used by the staff of the [[Valorum Center]] to keep dangerous inmates manageable.<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

[[Arla Fett]], sister of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], was kept under a heavy dose of sebenodone during her incarceration in the center. When she was rescued by [[Clan Skirata]], she had trouble adjusting when she was taken off the drug.<ref name="IC 501st" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''
